method: 36 native 1:1 grabs of the MAP 500 ms apart; pixel_x read as the small box's left edge minus 2 on each case tile; wire records logged from Fugue's 0x00f0 decoder with a temporary trace

slice.then: the original two steps, the first with StepDelay -10 (started a second earlier)

continue.steps: the first step, then the continuing step with flags 0 (sequential)

replace.steps: the first step, then a head step (flags 0x40000080, StepDelay 0)

slice.note: two runs; each alternates between two values 8 px apart, half the 1 s window apart

slice-once.note: holds at the window's end after one pass (two runs: 31 and 32), not at the settled 0

end-loop.note: stops at once on the settled appearance

parallel-color.model: rgb = base * (1 - p) + base * #00ff00 * p, p = progress (pixel_x / 16)
